import unittest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class TestPatientAppointment(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.patient_appointment = MagicMock()
        self.workflow_system = MagicMock()
        self.machine_learning_model = MagicMock()
        self.database_manager = MagicMock()

    def test_patient_appointment_creation(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-2
        self.patient_appointment.create_appointment.return_value = True
        result = self.patient_appointment.create_appointment(patient_id="P001", doctor_id="D001")
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_route_consultation_request(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-3
        self.workflow_system.route_request.return_value = "D001"
        result = self.workflow_system.route_request(patient_id="P001")
        self.assertEqual(result, "D001")

    def test_route_to_correct_chemist(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-4
        self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist.return_value = "C001"
        result = self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist(patient_pincode="12345", chemist_pincode="12345")
        self.assertEqual(result, "C001")

    def test_route_to_correct_lab(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-4
        self.workflow_system.route_to_lab.return_value = "L001"
        result = self.workflow_system.route_to_lab(patient_pincode="12345", lab_pincode="12345")
        self.assertEqual(result, "L001")

    def test_predict_disease(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-5
        self.machine_learning_model.predict_disease.return_value = "DiseaseX"
        result = self.machine_learning_model.predict_disease(symptoms=["symptom1", "symptom2"])
        self.assertEqual(result, "DiseaseX")

    def test_retrain_model(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-6
        self.machine_learning_model.retrain_model.return_value = True
        result = self.machine_learning_model.retrain_model(new_data=[{"symptom": "symptom1", "disease": "DiseaseX"}])
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_database_maintenance(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-7
        self.database_manager.maintain_database.return_value = True
        result = self.database_manager.maintain_database()
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_archive_inactive_patients(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-8
        self.database_manager.archive_inactive_patients.return_value = True
        three_years_ago = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=3*365)
        result = self.database_manager.archive_inactive_patients(last_consultation_date=three_years_ago)
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_consultation_request_volume_lower_bound(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-9
        self.workflow_system.handle_requests.return_value = True
        requests = [{"patient_id": f"P{i}", "doctor_id": "D001"} for i in range(10000)]
        result = self.workflow_system.handle_requests(requests)
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_consultation_request_volume_upper_bound(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-9
        self.workflow_system.handle_requests.return_value = True
        requests = [{"patient_id": f"P{i}", "doctor_id": "D001"} for i in range(50000)]
        result = self.workflow_system.handle_requests(requests)
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_consultation_request_volume_exact_bound(self):
        # VIRTUA-2.5-9
        self.workflow_system.handle_requests.return_value = True
        requests = [{"patient_id": f"P{i}", "doctor_id": "D001"} for i in range(25000)]
        result = self.workflow_system.handle_requests(requests)
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_invalid_patient_id(self):
        # Negative test case for VIRTUA-2.5-2
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            self.patient_appointment.create_appointment(patient_id="", doctor_id="D001")
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "Invalid patient ID")

    def test_invalid_doctor_id(self):
        # Negative test case for VIRTUA-2.5-3
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            self.workflow_system.route_request(patient_id="P001", doctor_id="")
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "Invalid doctor ID")

    def test_invalid_chemist_pincode(self):
        # Negative test case for VIRTUA-2.5-4
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist(patient_pincode="12345", chemist_pincode="")
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "Invalid chemist pincode")

    def test_invalid_lab_pincode(self):
        # Negative test case for VIRTUA-2.5-4
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            self.workflow_system.route_to_lab(patient_pincode="12345", lab_pincode="")
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "Invalid lab pincode")

    def test_invalid_symptoms(self):
        # Negative test case for VIRTUA-2.5-5
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            self.machine_learning_model.predict_disease(symptoms=[])
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "Symptoms list cannot be empty")

    def test_invalid_new_data(self):
        # Negative test case for VIRTUA-2.5-6
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            self.machine_learning_model.retrain_model(new_data=[])
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "New data list cannot be empty")

    def test_invalid_last_consultation_date(self):
        # Negative test case for VIRTUA-2.5-8
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            self.database_manager.archive_inactive_patients(last_consultation_date=None)
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "Last consultation date cannot be None")
